Initial release of label-compliance-checker.

- Provides decision support for medical device label compliance based on official rules.
- Covers TH-MED-004 domain and outputs decision results in JSON IR format.
- Supports command-line parameter input and demo mode for sample checking.
- References official regulatory source: "Regulations on Medical Device Instructions and Labels" (Order No.6, Articles 10–11).
- Outputs error codes and risk warnings; not intended as legal or regulatory conclusions.
